inicio.title: Símbolos do Self · online analytical psychology (Jung), by Luiza Fernandes Bezerra
inicio.description: An online analytical-psychology (Jung) practice for Brazil and abroad. Analytically-oriented psychotherapy and career guidance with psychologist Luiza Fernandes Bezerra.

perguntas.title: Frequently asked questions
perguntas.description: Questions about analytical psychology and career guidance online: the first conversation, duration, frequency, fees, confidentiality, time zones, Brazil and abroad.

privacidade.title: Privacy
privacidade.description: What this site keeps — your choice of language, in your own browser, and anonymous aggregate visit statistics — and what it never does: identify, follow or personalise for the visitor.

primeiraConversa.title: The first conversation
primeiraConversa.description: What happens when you write: a conversation of about fifty minutes, by video, in English or Portuguese, in your own time zone, from Brazil or anywhere abroad. The steps, the fees, and a note already written for you to send.

sobre.title: About Luiza Fernandes Bezerra
sobre.description: Luiza Fernandes Bezerra, a clinical psychologist working in the analytical-psychology tradition: degree and advanced training at PUC-SP, postgraduate study at Instituto Numen, in clinical practice since 2014. Analytically-oriented psychotherapy and career guidance, online, in Portuguese and English, for Brazil and anywhere abroad.

internacional.title: Brazil and abroad
internacional.description: A Brazilian clinical psychologist working in the analytical-psychology tradition, entirely online: analytically-oriented psychotherapy and career guidance in English or Portuguese, in your own time zone, wherever in the world you live. I work with people in Portugal, England, the Netherlands, the United States and Canada; fees in dollars or euros.

orientacaoProfissional.title: Career guidance
orientacaoProfissional.description: Online career and vocational guidance with a clinical psychologist working in the analytical-psychology tradition, trained in career guidance at PUC-SP: up to twelve weekly meetings with psychological tests, conversations and proposed activities, to reach the profession that makes the most sense in your life right now. A first choice, a career change or a fresh start, in English or Portuguese, from Brazil and abroad.

analise.title: Analysis online · analytical psychology
analise.description: Online analytically-oriented psychotherapy with Luiza Fernandes Bezerra, a clinical psychologist working in the analytical-psychology tradition: weekly sessions in Portuguese or English, for anywhere in Brazil or abroad. Anxiety, grief, dreams, relationships, career and purpose.

analise.name: Analysis (analytically-oriented psychotherapy)
analise.description: Weekly online psychotherapy in the analytical-psychology tradition, in Portuguese and English, for Brazil and anywhere in the world.

orientacaoProfissional.name: Career guidance
orientacaoProfissional.description: An online programme of up to twelve weekly meetings, with psychological tests, conversations and activities, to choose or rethink a profession.
